title: Toxic Chief Executive Officers; Environmental, Social, and Governance Institutional Investors as Watchdogs; and the Labor Market Outcomes
eligible_reason: The treatment is not a staggered absorbing adoption. l1_EPAdum (and the count l1_EPAcase and log-penalty l1_EPApen variants) is a lagged firm-year indicator that the firm was subject to an EPA enforcement action in t-1; it switches on and off repeatedly (in the shipped sample 526 of 5,883 firms are ever enforced, 473 of them have at least one 1-to-0 switch and 233 have more than one 0-to-1 switch). Every column also includes ten time-varying firm/CEO controls with firm, state-by-year and industry-by-year fixed effects (reghdfe ... a(firmid stateid#year sic2#year)). Table 4 reweights with entropy balancing; Table 5 uses a stacked estimator (stackedev) around staggered state environmental-budget increases (9 state cohorts 2008-2018, 15 never-treated states) but the regressors are the EPA indicator interacted with relative-time dummies, with covariates; Table 6-8 and Figure 3 (leads and lags of the EPA indicator) follow the same template. No specification regresses an outcome on an absorbing binary treatment with unit and time fixed effects.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 2002-2020 (RegressionSampleFirm.Short.dta: 47,664 firm-years, 5,883 firms). Outcomes: turnover (CEO dismissal indicator), outsideseats (CEO's outside board seats), againstvote/againstdummy (director-level voting, RegressionSampleVoting.Short.dta), CEO/COO/CFO rehiring (TrackingCEOs.Short.dta). Table 2 (MainTablesandFigures.do line 55): reghdfe turnover l1_EPAdum + controls, a(firmid stateid#year sic2#year), cluster(stateid year); then l1_EPAcase, l1_EPApen; same for outsideseats. Table 3: pre-2010 vs post-2009 split of the EPA variables. Table 4: ebalance weights. Table 5 (line 176): stackedev turnover l1_EPAdumrel_m1 ... rel_2 if RelativeYear in [-2, 2], cohort(Yeartreated) time(year) never_treat(NoTreat) unit_fe(firmid) clust_unit(stateyearid) covariates(...). Table 6: rehiring of CEOs after EPA vs non-EPA departures. Table 7: voting with DirectorID FE; SRI ownership interactions. Table 8: violation type and media coverage interactions. Figure 3 (line 364): p3..p1 leads and l1..l3 lags of EPAdum with controls.
estimators_reported: stacked_event_study (stackedev) with EPA x relative-time interactions
n_adoption_cohorts_note: EPA enforcement is a recurring pulse, not an adoption. The auxiliary state budget-increase variable Yeartreated has 9 cohorts (2008 x4, 2009 x2, 2010 x9, 2012, 2013 x2, 2014 x2, 2015 x3, 2016 x3, 2018; 15 never-treated states) but is used only to define stacked cohorts in Table 5, not as the treatment.
modern_estimators_note: stackedev (stacked event study, Cengiz et al. style) in Table 5; not CSA/BJS/SA/dCDH.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment is a non-absorbing lagged enforcement pulse; time-varying controls; state-year and industry-year FE are fine but the design is not staggered adoption
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if the firm had an EPA enforcement action in year t-1 (switches on/off); l1_EPAcase = number of cases; l1_EPApen = log penalties
specs.controls: l1_zscore l1_bindep l1_closeheld l1_instown l1_logasset l1_ebitratio l1_logage l1_logexper l1_femgender l1_awards (lagged, time-varying firm and CEO controls)
l1_zscore l1_bindep l1_closeheld l1_instown l1_logasset l1_ebitratio l1_logage l1_logexper l1_femgender l1_awards (lagged, time-varying firm and CEO controls)

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked estimator; regressors are EPA indicator x relative-time interactions (triple interaction); covariates
specs.treatment_var: l1_EPAdumrel_m1 l1_EPAdumrel_0 l1_EPAdumrel_1 l1_EPAdumrel_2 (and case/pen variants)
specs.treatment_definition: l1_EPAdum x 1[year - Yeartreated == k], Yeartreated = year of state environmental-budget increase (cohorts 2008-2018), NoTreat = never-treated states
specs.controls: l1_bindep l1_closeheld l1_instown l1_logasset l1_ebitratio l1_zscore l1_logage l1_logexper l1_femgender l1_awards
specs.notes: The state budget increase itself is never used as the DiD treatment on an outcome.

specs.exclusion_reason: leads and lags of a non-absorbing pulse indicator; controls
specs.treatment_var: p3_EPAdum p2_EPAdum p1_EPAdum l1_EPAdum l2_EPAdum l3_EPAdum (and case/pen)
specs.treatment_definition: leads (p) and lags (l) of the EPA enforcement indicator
specs.controls: l1_zscore l1_bindep l1_closeheld l1_instown l1_logasset l1_ebitratio l1_logage l1_logexper l1_femgender l1_awards (lagged, time-varying firm and CEO controls)

data_access_note: Regression-ready 'Short' Stata files for every table and figure are shipped (BoardEx/Compustat/ISS/EPA-derived); no README beyond Summary text.txt, which does not describe any disguising.
data_files: StatesBudgetIncrease.dta (564 x 5) and StateRegressions.dta (25,932 x 49; Table 5)
replication_feasible_note: Package is complete and runnable, but no eligible specification exists.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Switching pattern of l1_EPAdum verified in RegressionSampleFirm.Short.dta; state budget cohorts from StatesBudgetIncrease.dta. Flags cite Baker-Larcker-Wang; the only staggered component (state budgets) enters a stackedev triple-interaction design.
